name: user-question
description: A complete head-and-shoulders avatar beside a question mark.
useCase: Show an account needing clarification or open account help.
misuse: Label the account action or status explicitly; the symbol alone does not establish identity or permission.

16.reason: A full question hook and larger dot remain distinct beside the shared avatar at text size.

24.reason: The head uses the shared interface avatar radius; both complete shoulders and the separate marker retain generous clear gaps.
